name: Masha-mod
source:
Have you ever wondered what Masha was thinking about when you read through Miku-route? Was it an empty hysteria, or completely justified behavior?

We will look at the world from the perspective of the same Masha who took part in those very shootings. Have you ever wondered why she acted like that? Read the mod and maybe you'll understand her a little more.
translation:
你有没有想过，当你读完初音未来的时候，玛莎在想什么？这是一种空洞的歇斯底里，还是完全正当的行为？

我们将从参与那些枪击事件的同一个玛莎的角度来看待世界。你有没有想过她为什么会有这样的行为？阅读mod也许你会更了解她一点。
